⚔️ 武侠博弈是核心，公平与玩法也有亮点 - 博弈体验独特： 普攻、振刀、霸体的三角克制逻辑，再搭配飞索三维战场，冷兵器博弈的爽感是其他同类型游戏很难替代的。 - 付费公平无氪： 所有对局内战力相关内容全部免费，没有任何数值付费门槛，零氪玩家完全可以凭技术碾压氪金玩家。 - 玩法覆盖多元： 除了核心大逃杀模式，还有PVE闯关、娱乐乱斗、摸金等多种玩法，能同时满足硬核竞技和休闲刷图的需求。 - 硬件适配友好： 低配置设备也能稳定运行，不用为了玩游戏专门升级电脑，普通玩家也能获得流畅的操作体验。 ⚠️ 上手、外挂、资源和社交，都是实际短板 - 新手门槛偏高： 核心的振刀、连招、身法需要大量练习，新手很容易被老玩家碾压，前期挫败感很强。 - 外挂治理有短板： 官方虽然持续封禁外挂账号，但高段位依然存在不少外挂，部分外挂甚至能锁定玩家追击，破坏竞技公平。 - 运营资源倾斜： 官方后续资源更多向手游倾斜，端游原创内容更新节奏变慢，部分老玩家的需求得不到及时响应。 - 社交体系薄弱： 缺少深度社交绑定的玩法，好友互动、公会战队相关功能不完善，玩家的社交粘性不足。 🧭 按玩法偏好选模式，再决定投入多少时间 - 如果你是第一次接触永劫无间，优先从三排模式入手。不用强行练高难度连招，先熟悉基础博弈逻辑，就能获得不错的体验。 - 如果你是单排爱好者，建议先在人机模式里把基础操作练熟，再逐步提升段位，避免刚进匹配就被老玩家碾压。 - 如果你对竞技公平性要求极高，建议先观察近期的外挂治理情况，再决定要不要长期投入时间游玩。

I guess I would recommend this game but I'm personally very mixed on it. While the art, world building, voice acting and characters are all great, I find the story and gameplay to be lackluster. Especially for a rogue lite. It lacks variety, so runs become stale pretty quickly, and while most rogue likes could be beaten on your first run with a lot of luck, Hades is not designed to be beaten on your first run. The story is praised a lot, too, but from what I've seen it's pretty barebones. There's some world-building and lore you can find, but the main plot is pretty boring. I found myself skipping through dialogue in the lobby because it took too long and only 10% of the time was there new information. I find the game to be a bit clunkily executed, especially if you're a rogue-like veteran. So my judgment is this: If you love rogue likes, don't bother with this one, it'll lack variety for you and become stale quickly. But if you want to get into rogue likes then this is the perfect entry point for you, and probably why this game entered the mainstream in the first place.

Incredible game. Not that difficult (first tried 90% of bosses), but it doesn't have to be hard because it is so fun! I knew nothing about Journey to the West, aside from 3 things: - Wukong is a mischievous monkey that achieved Buddhahood - He has a boar-human friend - He is the inspiration for Goku So it was a bit weird seeing a bunch of talking animals, but you can still easily follow the story. So you'll still have fun. Banger music, especially "Listen Not". The game runs fine?????? With my laptop, the gameplay (the important part) runs smoothly on the default setting, but the cutscenes stutters a bit, which is odd since it is a cutscene? The game also has this weird afterimage effect when something moves, I don't know if it is normal, but I have seen other peoples' gameplay with the same effect. The combat is super fun. It might get a little stale using the same weapon the whole game (I used the Thrust Stance all the way through) but it just makes the final boss more fun because he has your moveset BUT cooler and you will easily recognize these moves and lock in, due to already being familiar with their game . Despite that, my favorite boss is actually a secret boss Erlang Shen , which was also the hardest boss here (22 attempts). He is super fun and has a great rhythm to the fight, which is really enough to sell me on a fight. This game feels like it wants to be a Boss Rush with how many bosses there are, and it great! All bosses are well designed and fun to fight, except Yellow Loong, and Bishui Golden-Eyed Beast, those 2 are dookie and not fun. The Fire Mantle only makes the fight bearable, not fun. Honorable mention to Cyan Loong, but once you figure out his tell for his stupid twirl forward attack, he becomes easy. If you plan to 100% this game, you are required to do a ng+, at least up to chapter 5 and fight the Bishui Golden-Eyed Beast again for some materials. LITERALLY I DON'T WANT TO FIGHT THAT THING AGAIN!!! I AM DONE WITH FIRE!!! -1 for the Bishui Golden-Eyed Beast. VERY fun game. I may not get all the references, but I am glad the devs made a game THEY want to make. I would recommend this to most people who wants a fun action game.

text_clean: 上古卷轴5是真正最让我有一种自己穿越到了异世界的感受的游戏，B社在开放世界RPG中的诸多设计，都重在让玩家做自己而非扮演某个既定的角色，我可以随心所欲地自由探索、做任何事。一方面，这个世界不仅有着足够厚重的历史背景与世界观塑造，当下正在发生的、能参与的大小事件与故事也极其丰富；另一方面，它不像别的游戏那样有一个存在感非常强的主线脉络牵着你走、让人产生一种推“进度条”的感觉——上古卷轴5的主线任务本质上更像一条体量较大的支线，完成后旅程并不会就此结束，真正的主线其实是玩家自己在这个世界里体验所有内容的先后顺序，始终给人一种没有终点的漫游感。同时，玩上古卷轴5时的会有的一种沙盒的感觉也非常的重要，是能够即开即玩让我一秒沉浸，也可以随时放下的游戏，没有一点点的负担。因此对我个人来说，上古卷轴5的游玩感受是从系统层面和底层逻辑上就与其他游戏完全不一样，这种沉浸代入感是几乎完全无法被其他任何游戏替代的。

The story is very written very poorly and is very boring, the different islands you go are mostly bland and uninspired landscapes with very little details that immerse you in the game. Your base becomes a habitat full of administrative tasks that keep you running back and forth from chests to the thing you're working on and it doesn't feel great. The movement itself feels sluggish and like you don't quite exist in the world due to the floaty yet sluggish feel of the character and how they interact with the geometry in the world. I had a fun time but I left with a lot to desire upon completing the game. I think this idea will likely be taken by another team with a similar idea and elevate the experience, which I welcome as this game certainly has good bones but a poor presentation of everything else. 6/10 wouldn't recommend.

I thought the city and map was very well designed. It was really fun figuring out how to traverse the environment to get to where I wanted to go. Zombies weren't really a problem at all. It's been a while since I played the first game but I recall being out at night scared me quite a bit because it was actually dangerous. But I never had any problems with zombies in this game at all. It seems they put a lot more focus on the human enemies but I don't think I ever got close to dying from enemies. I did die a couple of times from falling to my death though. I think I would've enjoyed this game significantly more if I could get more immersed into the story and the world itself. Without that it's much harder for this game to really bring me in so I guess it's impressive that they managed to do that somewhat with how good the general gameplay is.

Bermain Don't Starve Together (DST) bersama teman adalah salah satu pengalaman co-op survival terbaik yang pernah saya rasakan. Gim ini tidak sekadar menuntut kita untuk mencari makan, tetapi juga bertahan dari kejamnya perubahan musim dan berbagai ancaman monster yang tidak terduga. Kedalaman mekanik gim ini sangat memuaskan. Manajemen inventaris, rotasi cuaca—mulai dari musim dingin yang membekukan hingga musim panas yang rawan kebakaran—serta variasi bos membuat setiap sesi bermain selalu menantang. Mati berkali-kali di gim ini adalah hal biasa, dan itu justru menjadi pelajaran berharga untuk mengatur strategi base-building yang lebih matang di ronde berikutnya. Namun, hal yang paling patut diapresiasi dari DST adalah dedikasi luar biasa dari pihak developer, Klei Entertainment. Untuk sebuah gim yang dirilis bertahun-tahun lalu, mereka masih sangat konsisten memberikan update konten masif, rework karakter, serta event musiman secara gratis sampai detik ini. Perhatian dan komitmen mereka terhadap komunitas pemain benar-benar mantap. Secara keseluruhan, dengan harga yang sangat terjangkau (terlebih sering ada diskon yang otomatis memberikan ekstra satu copy untuk diberikan ke teman), DST adalah sebuah masterpiece. Jika Kalian mencari tantangan survival yang sesungguhnya dan punya teman untuk diajak menjadi idiot bersama, gim ini wajib ada di library kalian. 10/10. Sayangnya, saya tidak mempunyai teman lagi bermain untuk bermain bersama di DST hahaha

Look at these subjects! They build stone walls, hoard food in chests, and pray to a science machine as if it might grant them salvation. They believe that if they only toil hard enough, Winter will spare them. But the Shadow is already here. It sits right behind them, waiting for that pathetic sanity meter to drop. The game offers no promise of victory - only a brief reprieve. True wisdom lies not in constructing an impregnable fortress, but in building a campfire, sitting beside it, listening to the logs crackle, and accepting that, come morning, you must venture back into the cold, unforgiving woods. Not for the sake of some grand purpose, but simply because this is the rhythm of the world - a rhythm that possesses a strange, harsh beauty. It is a mechanism that establishes an obsessive-compulsive structure through a cycle of resource management, where the "Other" manifests as an impersonal Law of lack, and *jouissance* is tethered to the ritual of averting catastrophe. It is the position of an obsessive captive to ritual: you act - not to gain recognition or reach a conclusion, but because to stop would mean confronting the Real - the very thing the ritual was designed to forestall. In this sense, *Don't Starve Together* constructs an obsessive position: a subject caught between anxiety and fleeting relief. Here, the subject attempts to govern the Real through ritual - a process structurally akin to a neurotic’s endeavor to cope with lack.

Upon writing this review, I've almost clocked in 72 hours hours in this game, I've completed the main story, and I'm still working towards 100% completion. And honestly? I'm still not tired of it. I love everything about this game. The dialogues, the story progression, the character development, the way every character feels like an actual person with their own personality and history. The way the story unfolds naturally as you keep playing, even when you're dying over and over again, is just brilliant. You don't feel like you're grinding through the same content. You feel like you're slowly becoming part of this world. And then there's the gameplay. Every run feels like its own little adventure. The randomness keeps things fresh, and the weapons are so incredibly unique that switching between them genuinely changes the way you approach a run. The different weapon aspects add even more variety, and the sheer number of boons you can acquire and combine to create some absolutely ridiculous builds is just *chef's kiss*. There's something incredibly satisfying about finding a combination that works perfectly and watching everything fall into place. But what I appreciate the most is how seamlessly everything comes together. The gameplay, the writing, the progression, the characters, the music, the art style. Nothing feels like it's there just to fill space. Even failure feels like progress, and that's something I absolutely adore about this game. While I have finished the main story, I still have things left to discover, builds to experiment with, and reasons to keep coming back. And that's probably the biggest compliment I can give a game like this. Supergiant Games absolutely nailed it. 11/10. Absolutely loving it. If you're even remotely interested in roguelikes, do yourself a favour and play this game.

It's not bad but certainly not elite and on balance I unfortunately have to not recommend it. It feels like a much worse 'Slay the Spire' minus the deck-building. After a while, it gets a bit repetitive and boring: the same passages, rewards and enemies... Yes you build up to fighting different bosses but there wasn't quite enough variety to keep me hooked - Slay the Spire manages this way better. I also feel like it isn't balanced correctly. The whole premise is that your decisions are permanent so your 'favourite heroes' die if you make a mistake - but at the same time you have a near infinite supply of new heroes who you don't even have to pay to recruit. As such, the stakes don't feel nearly as high the game suggests. Also, all the heroes are basically different skins of the same type of hero. If you boil down their abilities, they're all quite similar: all of them have some combination of healing, de-stealthing, multi-target attack and single-target attack. I've never built my roster and thought: wow I definitely need this type of hero in it... All in all, it's probably worth giving a go if discounted but certainly not at full price.

I really don't get the hype, it's a grindy game that has quick and slippery controls with combat that is way too fast and chaotic and gameplay that gets really repetitive Before you judge me, I've played roguelikes, I know what to expect, Inscryption, Hades, Isaac, ETG, all examples of great games that are very clear and understandable In a nutshell, usually, you'll have way too many things happening on screen at once, which would make you maximize your damage so you don't have to deal with dodging attacks And that's the biggest problem, it's trying to be a fast paced game without really nailing what makes a fast game work, it has annoying side missions, missing keys, obscure shortcuts, and so many dead ends. Neither are the bosses or the elite encounters fun, felt like they were really basic in their design, and you would kill them only if you get lucky with good build, without really requiring any sort of skill or strategy And as for visuals, despite the pixel art being detailed, everything in the world was all blending into one another to really not give you any sort of visual clarity during fights Most of all, I hate it's DLCs, and how they shove these in your face in many of the doors you get to, I've encountered them throughout my third playthrough and it just felt like a mobile F2P game at some points If you were to ask me, if it looks interesting to you, buy it, and judge it based on the first hour, as it wouldn't get any more interesting than that, otherwise, just refund it, don't keep it like I did expecting something else With the overwhelmingly positive reviews I was sure I was missing something, but it doesn't seem like it, so if it wasn't clear, no, I wouldn't really recommend the game, but I would encourage you to try it if it seems interesting

The truth is that this is a bad game, I do not recomend it... Now that the joke is over, the game is only worth it if you buy the Anthology pack. The Anthology pack includes all the expansions necessary to mod the hell out of the game and it also allows you to play with interesting Civs and game modes; the game is a little boring if you don't play with Rise and Fall or Gathering Storm. I usually run between 150 to 200 mods, UI mods are necessary (map tacks, simple UI adjustments, extended policies, etc) but other mods are optional if recommended (from aesthetic mods like Colder tundra, to entire Civilizations like Sukritact's Siam) . Here is a list of good modders, if it's made by them the mod is usually really good: Sukritact (the best modder out there, with mods like Sukritact's Oceans and lots of Civ changes/new civs), JNR (interesting terrain mods and new mechanics), Leugi and Pokiehl.

Journey to the West is one of my favorite mythology tails, so I knew I'd been playing this sooner or later. Sadly, 20ish hours in I just don't feel compelled to progress further. There are many aspects I like: for one, haven't played a combat this satisfying since Ghost of Tsushima. Mastering your own evolving skills and learning enemies patterns really feels rewarding - choreography and cinematics are great and I never felt frustrated once. Obscure lore is big plus for me in the way it's presented and delivered. Voices in the wind, riddles and a lot of hinting to Sun Wukong's myth are amazing. And visuals are really top notch. But there are some huge problems that such bright sides can't hide for long. There are basic upgrades hidden behind missable NPCs quest. There are missable bosses and encounters that lock themselves until NG+ without any hint. Most things don't have any trigger to signal the player something has changed, or that his actions had an impact - resulting in potentially missing stuff you actually unlocked or progressed towards. Some bosses / encounters straight up negate some builds, not letting you use whatever playstyle suits you the most. These points are straight up bad design choices that ultimately hinder the two best aspects of this game, leaving it carried by its visuals. If you like souls-inspired boss rushes, I'd suggest buying at a fairly discounted price.

I have a hard time describing this game. There is so much love devoted to every inch of it. if you just mash through the menus, and watch the numbers go up, its great. but if you really pay attention and slow down a little, this game is absolutely incredible. every detail of every map makes me feel like i'm inside a beautiful continent, and experiencing the combat is rich and engaging, both in the original format; land battles, and sea battles as well. theres such a huge difference between being tactician and getting involved int he battle and you choose that every time, whether you want to send troops and simulate the battle, or simulate the battle, coordinate your troops and just sit there, or let them watch you handle the entire army on your own. I loved: The immersive gameplay, getting to walk through town, interact and involve yourself in sieges and battles and make a difference. The complexity is rewarding, you can achieve so much in this game, and each choice gives a different gameplay style. Beautiful sets, beautiful graphics. What i noticed: It was a bit heavy on my computer, which is understandable it is not a gaming pc. There are some pretty noticable graphical glitches that i cannot seem to isolate, but when they aren't happening, everything is spectacular. mods and community development is great as the community is very involved in making this game as expansive as the developers originally intended. What i didn't like: Some of the quests and missions were a bit repetitive in my opinion. certain actions would clog up the notifcation screen and this would often get in the way of gameplay. gameplay loop is very fun, but some small part of me wants to see more creative aspects of the game being exercised: for example i was very disappointed that i couldn't "walk about the ship" if i was paused at sea, with the warsails mod. (i am not entirely sure if warsails is made by taleworlds as well, if it is not, please disregard.) I wish we could have more control over villages, like production, mayors, or something to feel like you really are a providing landlord, but i am not appropriately versed in economics and game theory to explain how. in my opinion the only way it could be better is if it was more cosmopolitical drama to make us more acquainted with characters because i feel like sometimes i just hear the same dialogue again and again, and i would love to see some social settings fleshed out. oh, and sometimes, there are some gamebreaking math bugs in th the autobattle feature, where one man defends against full armies, and it has happened a few times, and it was really hilarious, but a little demoralizing. this is one of the best games i've ever played with the most well rounded gameplay and the best combat, economics and overall gameplay i've experienced since i was 10, playing kessen, and pikmin and wishing i could do both at the same time. 9.9/10

A beautiful and scenic game that is undercut and overwritten by BEES. want to hear the wash of the waves, the call of seagulls, the creak of wood, and the putter of old engines? sorry, all you get is BEES. for some reason BEES were made to be the cornerstone of all mid-late game progression and their sound radius is so loud and so wide it spoils much of the ambiance of the game in solo play. A pleasantly simple and elegant crafting system in which you use a few metal ingots to craft a nice upgrade to your wooden spear. the progression feels smooth and rewarding with just the right amount of granularity and you better have an autoclicker because you need to click precisely 120 times to fill the recycler to make money for the trader. you need to fill it 8-10 times to get enough money to by the various valuable and vital things from the trader. it takes 7 clicks to plant and harvest a crop that feeds you for 8 minutes, 7 more to cook it, plus more clicks to add wood, more clicks to manage inventory, even more clicks and inventory juggling to make more complex foods. refilling your water bottle once is five clicks. everything is clicks. a few things have auto-act when you hold down the key or click, but most things do not. it's a fun experience with friends, a peaceful experience playing solo, and the game overwrites all of your backup saves if you die, forcing you to use its respawn mechanic which deletes all your inventory because fuck you. this is fine early on but lategame it gets incredibly grindy. in the final chapter of the game there's an area completely underwater. you need oxygen tanks. multiple of them. each one takes 30-40 clicks to make and a bunch of time spent managing the smelters. plus multiple sets of flippers each of which takes another 20+ clicks to make. some of the traps in that part of the game instant kill you from full health with full armor on, and the game deletes all of those items and overwrites all your saves.

《星际战甲》差评：增幅器削弱，把坐牢体验焊死了 钢铁回廊本就是一场漫长的折磨，爆率低、任务流程繁琐、敌人强度层层堆叠，玩过的都懂什么叫“坐牢”。之前还能靠增幅器的高效输出和流畅手感稍微缓解一下这种枯燥，现在好了，直接一刀砍废，连最后一点降低时间成本的途径都没了。 1. 本就坐牢，现在更是雪上加霜：钢铁回廊的机制决定了它必须投入大量时间重复刷取，之前增幅器的147配置至少能让我在刷的过程中有点爽快感，不用全程硬扛着高压和枯燥。现在削弱之后，输出效率下降、手感变得黏糊，原本靠配装能弥补的体验缺口，现在全要靠硬肝来填。 2. 削弱的是手感，更是玩家的耐心：我不是追求极限伤害的大佬，只是想靠着增幅器让坐牢过程没那么难熬。现在好了，官方直接把这点舒适区砍掉，仿佛在说“你们就该老老实实坐牢，别想靠配装偷懒”。 3. 补偿和改动完全不对等：这点补偿连重新适应削弱后的手感都不够，更别说弥补我本来就被拉长的坐牢时间。对de来说可能只是调整数值，对我们来说，是把本来就难熬的体验又往上加了一层枷锁。 钢铁回廊本就够折磨人了，现在连增幅器这点缓解手段都没了，以后刷起来只会更枯燥、更耗时。如果连玩家靠合理配装降低坐牢成本的途径都要堵死，那这游戏还有什么让人坚持下去的动力？

游戏制作精良，延续了前作突破和占点的玩法。 问题也很明显，匹配匹了3分钟进不去任何一把游戏，社区服全世界一共十多场游戏，一款多人联机游戏竟然要靠加入大量的人机和主要游玩人机模式进行续命，相当于买了一个多枪支暴揍人机的奇妙射击游戏。人机武器还单一，都是每个兵种最基础的那几把枪。 链接也是老问题了，很容易掉线，没个加速器基本玩不了，进游戏也是链接半天。 每个兵种解锁枪支和枪支配件条件很苛刻，但是打人机可以解锁配件这一点弥补了配件解锁的这个缺陷，升级非常慢解锁枪支依靠等级，玩了30个小时才升到20级，一大半的枪都用不了 兵种设计也是很有问题，这也是现代战争的硬伤，每个兵种在枪支挑选上通用而且并没有出现每个兵种擅长哪类枪械，然后就能看到志愿兵带个子弹包在后面窝着打狙，医疗兵扛着轻机枪疯狂扫射，冲锋枪成了时代败笔，伤害又低备弹少子弹也少除了野牛（这更是废物）

Hades is probably the first proper action game I've played. Honestly, I didn't think I'd like a "repetitive" game, but Hades *is* genuinely fun (and frustrating lol), and I found myself deeply enjoying the story and inter-personal character developments. Beautiful character and background designs and phenomenal voice acting as well, though I personally did wish for different accents since the characters are Greek and North African, and fat characters. The gameplay is challenging, and I will not lie, it was difficult to like as a complete newbie, but the frustration of losing is also very motivating and it never felt like the game was insurmountable. And, there is a god-mode for those who prefer to play for the story instead as well. I do want the House Contracter's pricing to be cheaper though; that shit is day(or night)time robbery T-T

Excellently Balanced and gets quite challenging at higher ascensions especially at Ascension 20. Beating Act4 on there is no joke. Missing some QoL which can be added back in with mods. Speaking of mods, it really feels infinitely moddable with the amount of additional content that can be added to it. Downfall expansion mod basically adds a whole new separate campaign on top of the base game. In comparison to the second game wise, Ironclad's and Defect's kits feels similar but still distinctly different, silent is comparable between the two games although game context makes it feel different. Watcher, Necrobinder and Regent are completely different experiences altogether. The only thing really feeling missed in the first game is the multiplayer aspect of the second, but even then there are mods which can achieve similar thing. All that being said, STS1 and STS2 are both excellent games which i've put hundreds of hours combined and would reccomend getting both if able to experience the difference in design philosophy between the two games

text_clean: 我要给⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐五颗星 从13年传奇版玩到现在的游戏，本人特别喜欢开放世界RPG游戏，算是最喜欢的游戏之一。游戏剧情特别丰富，世界观也很特色，BGM也非常好听，有一种厚重的历史感和神话感，尤其游戏里夜晚的时候跑着跑着来到山顶或者大海那边，BGM响起的时候，感觉置身其中，有一种空灵的孤寂。游戏里有非常多的NPC，几乎每个有名字的NPC都有自己的故事和人设，就好像一个个真实存在的人，有各种各样的故事各种各样的性格，支线比主线量多很多。玩过很多这种类型的游戏，但是只有老滚是我觉得真的在扮演自己的角色。游戏开始没有什么新手教程，就直接开始了任务，但是其实玩完才发现，游戏设计很有巧思，所有新手教程都在路上，玩着玩着就会了。 玩过的所有游戏里这个游戏是我玩的时间最久的，开放时间RPG游戏启蒙，至今找不到完美代餐。所有主线和支线全部刷完，地图也清空了N遍，最后只剩下反反复复的工会和领主任务，这大概花了两三年吧，当然中间我是有作弊过的，不然正常玩的话没有三五年很难清完这么多任务，快死的时候我会开无敌因为不想读档，也不得不作弊，因为有的任务卡bug了，只能用代码跳过或者重来。而且很多任务都有二选一或者阵营这种情况，一般我都会保存然后玩两遍任务看到两种不同的结局，但是像帝国和风暴斗篷这种阵营的剧情线比较长就不得不开两个档玩了。我有点完美主义和强迫症和收集癖，其实在清完任务和地图后，又反反复复清图，希望找到没有探索到的领域或者物品可以收藏或者什么隐藏任务。真的希望地图能再大些任务能再多些，如果有做不完的任务探索不完的地图就好了。 游戏本身很优秀，但是对于现在想入坑的人，我只能说谨慎，因为游戏太老，对比现在的游戏，首先画质差，新手引导差，自由度过高不知道做什么，接不完的任务，走着走着就不小心接了几个任务越堆越多，引擎也老，bug很多，新人很容易劝退，有很多人听说这个游戏好玩耐玩来玩，结果发现根本不是这样，觉得别人吹太过了，容易半途而废，所以不是适合所有人。 整合包和MOD比较考验耐心，如果想接触整合包和MOD，不建议花钱，就算找人安装了，后面的事情也很多，自己早晚要学会安装，自给自足丰衣足食。整合包和MOD的安装其实非常简单一看就会，耐心点不要跳步骤。难的是自己乱安装MOD导致的MOD冲突和排序问题，新手不建议自己乱装东西，游戏引擎很老，MOD和MOD之间兼容性没那么好，如果有补丁可以修复。注意百分之九十九的MOD都是免费的。 《Dragonborn》 喝撸啊喝啊撸啊嘿永不退永不退永不退永不退 帕拉丁 帕拉丁 让他血辉洒地 何谓难 何谓苦 抛向大海百川 拿起弩 拿起枪 我们雄心挑战 踏大地 踏大地 我们感恩未来 唯胜败领功尔以为敌付出何惧把宿命的厄运放下 天不怕地不怕信仰在 我们必须鼓众跨越阻碍站起来 不认输变成龙 让民主照中国 何苦难问苍天唱热歌 站在苍天中星魂白踏破宇宙 帕拉丁 帕拉丁 让他血辉洒地 何谓难 何谓苦 抛向大海百川 拿起弓 拿起杖 我们雄心挑战 踏大地 踏大地 我们感恩未来 查 查 查水表 查 查 查水表 夜不闭户裂谷城，种族平等大风盔。繁华明媚大冬堡，欢声笑语佛克瑞。人见人欺黑荆棘，乐善好施银血家。不计前嫌戴尔芬，坚守贞洁哈尔嘉。快嘴饶舌伊思本，沉默寡言西塞罗。美好童年蓝宝石，民风淳朴马卡斯。质量很轻龙鳞片，香甜可口加林根。黄金满贯随葬瓮，热情好客尸鬼君。 我以雪漫城男爵 伟大的杜瓦克因 屠龙者 龙语者 黑暗兄弟会之主 战友团首领 冬堡学院校长 盗贼工会会长 吸血鬼大君 黎明的开拓者与终结者 图留斯麾下的精兵 誓弃者摧毁者 破晓之光 黄昏之星 狡诈之面 血腥玫瑰 月光下的救世主 大衮之袭 食死徒 恶梦之王 十二魔神人间代言人的名义命令你放了我！

An agonizingly suffocating, sluggish and slow game. I have played many turn-based games, but they usually at least have some kind of pacing. Here, every dungeon has to be cleared multiple times - yes, they added a roguelike concept - because your heroes get scared, fall into depression, die and so on. But the point is that roguelikes are usually dynamic and there is no problem killing or running past the same enemy, since in games like Dead Cells or Rogue Legacy you can run through an entire level in literally a couple of minutes. Here, a single battle can easily take 3-5 minutes due to SLOOOW actions and SLOOOOOOOOW animations for every single action. I tried, I honestly tried. But no. It is like playing marathon battles in War Thunder over and over again - after playing, you are left with only a feeling of exhaustion, weariness and disappointment. And that is not even mentioning the town upgrade grind, resource gathering for building construction and so on. I would rather replay BG3 yet again and look at that octopus once more than launch this one more time (x_x)

我是P4G和P5R连着玩的 对我来说P4G就是一群高中生拯救伙伴打败大魔王的中二冒险故事，有一种纯正JRPG不用在乎太多细节设定，帅，爽，打就完事了，玩起来一路嘻嘻哈哈的就打完了 但是P5R这剧情真是从头到尾都让人想骂人 首当其冲的就是这个异世界导航APP，明明P4G里钻电视一样作为分割日常和异常的路径，P4G里钻电视却默认属于世界观的一环，不管怎么钻都没人会在意有人进了电视机不见了。但P5R这个异世界导航APP却不停地重复被人发现在马路上忽然消失作为剧情的爆点，不是哥们，你头一次被杏发现了还牵扯到女同学差点死了，结果就是不改，一大帮人天天在马路上玩消失深怕别人发现不了还不怕无辜路人被牵扯进去，明智丸喜都用发现异世界APP让人忽然消失和出现来察觉主角的身份显得主角这帮人真的就是一群弱智。 再就是明智这个小丑，早闻大名，真玩起来一开始以为是L这种角色，结果原来精神状态一直是最后一集的夜神月汗实在太小丑了，但更绷不住的是我听到双叶说“没有你的话，我就遇不到大家了！”，这是人说的话！？你生物妈死了就为你遇到好哥哥是吧，什么集美！？明智从头到尾都在嘲讽主角要杀主角组全家，结果主角组一直搁那“错不在你！你好可怜！我们原谅你！”衰我真在这让明智把这帮人全杀了灭了一次 狮童宫殿攻略完后，这剧情还算有点意思，社会意志不以个人行为转移，日本人选择了当鸵鸟无视狮童的犯罪事实，自欺欺人的相信强人政治只要狮童当选社会就能变好，自己又不愿意付出努力改变社会，霸凌排挤有清醒认知的人，和当代日本社会一模一样，本以为Atlas能有何高见，结果就是整个“圣杯”出来背锅，日本人变成这样都是圣杯害的！圣杯太坏了！草！ 想起之前玩破晓传说，轨迹系列等等JRPG，明明揭露了尖锐的社会矛盾问题，却简单的将问题归结在少数领导人或者某个敌人的阴谋，处理了这个“魔王”社会的一切不公，分配问题，阶级问题，种族问题就都解决啦！我可去NM的！没能力写政治戏和社会矛盾，那特么就别把这玩意写成主线啊，像P4G全程围绕救菜菜子谁关心一直在路边搞ZZ演讲的大叔在说啥。 路人学妹也是搞笑，P4G的玛丽我一直只当她是路人NPC，毕竟主线里真没啥戏份，但是这路人学妹强行给她加戏，最后2个迷宫又一点戏份不给，干脆和玛丽一样做成场外协助NPC不就得了，做成可操控角色又不让主线阶段使用，你是什么伙伴！？我认识你吗！？ 打完伪神尼玛的明智这小丑忽然冒出来给我吓一跳，原来P5R这逼死不了，恶心吐我了，直接卸载游戏视频站补完无印结局。

我的评价是：不如5代。 对于种田流玩家极度不友好，几乎逼着玩家尽快进入战争模式，尽快与AI交战。 先说发展： 同样的发展速度，同样的扩张速度，AI就是要比玩家发展得快，而且快很多。玩家还是中世纪时，就已经有AI发展到了原子时代。 更要命的是，蛮族的发展也要快于玩家，甚至能依靠先进的军事单位攻陷玩家的城池。玩家如果不开风灵月影，几乎需要五十个回合才能追平AI的发展速度。 再说外交： AI对玩家总是怀有深深的恶意，横挑鼻子竖挑眼。玩家军事能力弱的时候，个个都看不起，甚至会集体无端宣战，然后就一直拖着不和解。 可问题是，玩家与AI的交战，往往会被那些未交战状态的AI视为好战狂。这是什么逻辑？战争是AI挑起的，回头怪玩家过于暴力。 而且这些AI都表现得特别愣，要么宣战以后，稍微攻击他们的城池，他们立刻就请求和解。要么就死硬到底，哪怕丢城失地也不肯和解。 所以AI总是趋于调和的，你跟他们说：我占了你们的城池，投降吧。他们不肯。你用核弹洗地，他们就愿意和解了，甚至割城献地。 本作的战争几乎完全围绕制空权展开，地面部队完全成了摆设。只需要大力兴建机场和空中单位，就能瘫痪一个国家的陆军。地面仅需要维持快速机动兵力（直升机、坦克）占城即可。 五代那种防空车锁区的优势，再也不复存在。防空车只保护伴随的地面单位，而且十防九空，三架战斗机就能报销一辆防空车，自身无一损伤。 地面部队拉到边境，几乎完全成了靶子。只需要几个回合，就能将玩家辛辛苦苦培养的三星地面部队全部报销。 即使有了战斗机也无法形成空中优势，需要海量的战斗机巡航制空，才能避免空军单位损失。 最后再说操作： 可以说极其繁琐。 科研和行政拉到顶后，依然需要时不时勾选，就一个选项了，有什么好选的，不能循环吗？ 本作的AI占地逻辑极为愚蠢，城池建得极为密集。西安的郊外就是北京。我的好邻居图拉真，就接壤的一小块地，也要挤进去建一座城，真是有毛病啊。 部分建筑需要建在城外空地的设计，也是让人一头雾水，也就是说，每一座城，我都要算好哪些建筑要摆在郊外，然后规划用地。不能像五代那样，全都建在城里。 最后的话： 我算是模拟经营游戏的爱好者，文明五代和群星之类的游戏也没少玩。本作给我的感觉就是，不管你做什么，都比AI慢，不管你做什么，都有AI在骂。 整个游戏环境就跟火影村一样，玩家弱小的时候被霸凌，玩家强大了还是会被霸凌，霸之意志发作了属于是。 在其他游戏里，努力就会有回报。发展早，发展快，就是可以形成代差，就是可以欺凌弱小的国家。但在本作里，你发展得快（几乎不可能），AI会骂你。你发展得慢，AI就会对你宣战，然后骂你是战争狂。几乎找不到任何乐趣。

对于没有3d眩晕问题的玩家，绝对是款不可错过的好游戏。 所有美好体验的前提是不要看攻略，探路解密的设计非常出色： 诚然相比于在2026年很多引导都做成宝宝巴士的3a大作，半条命2的引导已经很“hard”了，但这正是一大乐趣所在，全程充满着“我试一下能不能成”的心态找出答案所反馈的惊喜。 虽然存在少数需要对上电波的解密，个人觉得整体难度尚可，只要稍有耐心多尝试下不同思路就不会卡关。 对比1代的体验，最大的感受是不再孤单压抑： 归功于引擎画面的提升和脚本演出的打磨，半条命2的叙事演出放在今天依然出色。v社将重力枪和ai队友的设计发挥的淋漓尽致，这些游戏早期就见识到的核心功能，到了后期仍然不会感到无聊，随着流程推进不断出现的新物品和新敌人相得益彰，配合着新地图总是能玩出花样。 最大的问题应该是开船作为第一个载具关做的有点冗长，且机动性不够用导致我在追踪弹堵存档点情况下需要反复sl极限存活；后面的载具关明显做的更加有趣且减负。其次有几个成就做起来很折磨。 玩完就能理解为什么要催v社出半条命3了

5000小时，n个赛季40挑战全通，n个10镜+角色的体验：糟糕至极。 (1）游戏纯纯为了不让玩家无敌通关设计，只管难，不管平衡，完全毁灭了角色扮演的本质：构筑一个角色从0开始慢慢变无敌。 用暗黑2举例，你无论选任何角色，只要靠肝都可以变得无敌通关，也都能打uber。poe恰恰相反，你无论选任何角色，哪怕用最op的bd，他也保证你有内容打不过: 自伤bd禁疗内容(emzebeler罪魂瓦尔多，uber maven 85贤主)一秒自杀打不了 瓦尔多2m远程没法打 瓦尔多罪魂百亢一击线低于150k物理300k元素没法打 瓦尔多罪魂百亢脱装-环效dps少于10亿根本不掉血 t16.5/t17 100deli多词条混沌伤(-30抗性/as extra chaos/wither)血流派都没法打即使3万血 深矿ehp低于500k没法打，dps低于1e没法打 综合一下要全通的角色需要10亿dps，走es ci，ehp500k+，元素一击300k+这样的角色赛季根本不存在。而这要求仅仅是能打，即是6门有比较大概率能过，不代表不死，甚至不代表6门一定通。 更别提终局平衡跟狗屎一样，你要强力的bd只能在以下选：t0 18耐力球ci勇士，护甲人，影陨卫士，t1 千力勇士，佣兵。这里面4/5近战，而且一共就这几个选项其他都是垃圾。你选了其他这游戏会变得奇难无比，你只能这也不打那也不打发挥阿q精神觉得自己很强。 arpg最重要的是rpg角色扮演，你今天游戏平衡狗屎一样的逼人只能玩某些他不喜欢的bd角色扮演在哪里？我是正好是近战爱好者，可是如果有个玩家他只喜欢玩弓手呢？他必须接受死的跟傻逼一样？稍微难一点的图就6门死光？ (2)装备太稀有，导致极大不公平 装备越稀有，价值越高，高到一定程度任何玩家通过努力肝都无法获得只能靠欧或者rmt导致游戏极度不公平。比如3.28赛季的双神龛腰带(加速/抗性，回响/抗性这些都是10镜起)，你要吗自己欧出来要吗rmt。人家欧一下10个镜子顶你核心玩家一赛季收益，普通玩家10赛季收益，这还怎么玩？你整个赛季肝几百小时就买人家欧一下。 装备稀有的另外一个副作用就是加剧通货膨胀的影响，1技能voices赛季初200d赛季中500d，赛季后1mirror，赛季末直接2mirror。然后你想要就要2mirror去买，这游戏稀有装备target farm都是亏损的(1voices刷simulacrum 333小时期望出一个，收益每小时对比普通策略亏损10d，即期望刷出时亏损2.3mirror)。这种稀缺加剧了通货膨胀导致的同工不同酬的不公平，赛季初肝10小时顶赛季末100小时。 (3)经济系统一坨屎，通货膨胀导致同工不同酬极度不公 这游戏核心玩家的收益从来不是刷图掉宝，从来都是靠首发优势快速积累第一桶金然后投资保值装备欺负萌新不懂赚钱。我每个赛季10镜子资本最多3镜子是自己刷的loot，起码7个镜子是靠前期200d买后期1镜的东西赚的。后进游戏的或者有工作不能全职玩的人只能看着200d的装备涨到1镜，然后他还没攒够钱买。 这游戏通货膨胀但是收益不膨胀，从第2周开始核心玩家就收益封顶了(20d/hr，有时候经济波动某些策略能30d/hr)。越到后面越没意思，你刷100个小时只为了买领先玩家开服刷1小时通货抢下来的萌新欧出来的稀缺装备。 ggg为了在一个没有足够内容的游戏里强行拖延玩家时间，现在就是纯纯的恶心人。现代游戏都这样，产能不够多做内容就调整一下现有内容的数值，加几个难度，也不管平衡，最后本来无限组合无限bd的游戏变成只有5个bd能玩。然后给你搞点永远刷不出来做不出来的装备拖延你游戏时间。最后你费尽千辛万苦做出来一身镜子装备选了最op的bd任然没法全通。他们已经不管你玩家是否在游戏中获得快乐了，他们只管赚钱。

神作！但是请谨慎购入游玩 蔚蓝这款游戏是一款极高难度的“横版平台跳跃游戏”（ 平台跳跃游戏，但是并没有平台 ），可以说是最难的横版平台跳跃游戏之一。所以，// 对于没玩过或只玩过一些简单的平台跳跃游戏，以及没有耐心的玩家，我极为不推荐你们游玩这款游戏！ //如果不听劝游玩，你将会被游戏的各种花样死法，以及各种365里路给劝退。随后怒打差评，并将游戏美美扔进库里吃灰并在之后后悔为什么要玩这款游戏。 但是！ 如果你是平台跳跃重度爱好者，并有着极高的耐心，那请你一定一定不要错过这款游戏。 以下是个人认为 蔚蓝的优缺点 （不喜勿喷） ------分界线------ 美术音乐 :无敌！画风虽然是像素，但十分的唯美精致，很好看。音乐那更是神中神，可以说是这款游戏的灵魂。其与关卡的配合更是游戏的最大魅力所在。例如:二三章被追逐时的刺激、第四张逆风而行时的紧张、第五章的神秘，恐怖、第六章在追坏madeline的紧张刺激等。当然对于我来说最为震撼的当然是第七章的登山；从最底端，到一步步上升，再到最终的登山。其音乐也是从一开始的比较单纯，到后来越来越丰富，再到临近登山时的那种震撼感，可以说完全无法用言语来表达。正因为这美术，音乐才给了我能坚持玩一下这款游戏的动力。总之，美术神！音乐神！ 玩法 :表面看上去，主角前期就只有冲刺这一个技能，甚至就连二段跳也是大后期才有。看上去未来是一款简单游戏，但并非如此，他表面上看上去基础技能简单，但所衍生出来的高级技巧十分多，更别提每一章都会新出1~3个新机制以及其衍生出来的高级技巧（ 以及更多花样的死法 ）。所以说，蔚蓝上限极为高，甚至有些高级技巧连作者都没想到，都是依靠玩家一点点发掘出来的。而在使用并成功利用各种技巧通关后的那一刻，成就感简直拉满。因此强烈去推进游玩，感受一下。总之，玩法强！ 剧情:我是skip党，没看过。 总结 :蔚蓝这一款游戏素以极高难度与强大的美术，音乐和剧情而闻名。许多人都被其难度而劝退，选择了云通关。但游戏的玩法和乐趣与其本身表达的内涵，终究还是需要亲身游玩才能去感受到（更别提官方还提供了帮助模式这一官方作弊器）但正如我前文所提到的，这游戏终究不适合大多数人坚持游玩下去，但我还是会希望读到这里的您去亲身体验一下这款游戏，谢谢。 当然，你问我是如何坚持游玩下去的？之前我可能会说被其美术，音乐与玩法。但现在的我会说: 因为山就在那里 。

Watch_Dogs 2 is a third person open world action/stealth game that takes the few things that were good about the first Watch_Dogs and pumps them up to 11. The game controls great, the free running is much more fluid, there's tons more side content and just general stuff to do. San Fransisco looks beautiful and it's actually insane how good this game still looks 10 years after release. The city is more vibrant and has more interesting locales than Watch_Dogs 1 and is really fun to roam around in and find stuff. It reminded me why the "Ubisoft open world" got so popular in the first place - when it's done well, it's a really fun playground! One of my biggest gripes about Watch_Dogs 1 was the overly edgy writing - this has been toned down in the sequel, albeit it's been replaced with what some might call "millenial cringe". Personally, I found it fun - a real time-capsule of the mid 2010s. The cast is fun and all the personalities are interesting without becoming grating caricatures Another thing they really improved on in the second game is the stealth. You now have actual options for it and just mowing down a whole compound of enemies is reasonably harder than in the first game. The quadcopter and jumper provide a lot of versatility for approaching encounters and there were some missions that to my great glee I managed to complete without ever setting foot in the restricted area All in all, if you miss the days when open worlds were cool instead of tiring busy-work, then I suggest getting this game on sale! It's great fun

This is probably my favorite game of all time, and I have at least double the hours in this then any other (Steam is showing about 1200 right now if that's important to you). I adore the Don't Starve series, and DST (Don't Starve Together) especially. It's a fantastic game with significantly more content then it looks like. I've been playing on an off since 2016 and there's always something new to work on or seek out (seriously there's a major update at least a few times a year with free content). The game lore is incredible, and well worth the time to understand and play toward. Not exactly a "horror" or "spooky" game, but it has a very cool Tim-Burton-esq art style and I have also found it fun to listen to halloween music while playing to heighten the ~vibes~. Most aspects of the game are customizable in game and world gen settings. So you can turn off frog rain if it's the bane of your Spring seasons, or play in an eternal autumn as one of my friends has done. You can increases bosses to lots, or turn out the lights for an entirely different run. If you just want to hang out and farm (with the incredibly complex farming system) you totally can, or you can completely ignore the mechanic all together. Whatever you like best you can spend time on, and if making a base or hunting bosses, or seafaring isn't up your alley there's enough content to skip your least favorite parts and still have so so much to do. But you'll have a more complete experience if you try a bit of everything. I have found that generally DST rewards time and knowledge spent, and the more difficult an enemy or obstacle appears, the more rewarding it is to conquer (and the better the loot too)! That said, this is a survival game, and it is hard. When players say everything can kill you, we're not exaggerating. There's a steep learning curve, especially from brand new to intermediate, and the game itself gives you little to no instruction. Don't panic. Part of the fun is experimenting and (probably) dying to something silly. (But if you want more explanation there are many amazing guides out there; I'm partial to the youtube ones myself.) If you're not a hardcore gamer, or don't pick up on gaming things quickly, same! I've been able to have so much fun at a beginner level and I still think this is worth it. If you're a more advanced player there are some really cool raid bosses to take on that I think you'll really enjoy. If you're into mods, there are many and they are super easily applied to the game (via Steam Workshop). Honestly, this game was the first I played with mods, and I'm sad every time I add mods to anything else because it's so much more work lol. I typically play solo, but multiplayer is active and enjoyable when I can convince people to play with me lol. I have found that it's generally good to get the basics down solo before attempting to play with others but ymmv. If DST is looking too overwhelming, maybe check out Don't Starve first. I really think this series is worth the effort, time, and money and if Together seems too far out of your skill level, the single player games might a better fit for you. Enemies have significantly lower heath pools, and the vanilla Don't Starve has a lot less going on in general. A great place to start if the art and story are interesting but you're not as interested in combat. I almost always play on my desktop but I have also played on a laptop as well as a Nintendo Switch (but not a Steam Deck, so might be different) and I found handheld/console really frustrating. It might be because I've put so many hours on pc that console controls really messed up my playing, but gameplay became clunky and overall less suited to controller or handheld gaming then I would have preferred. I really wouldn't suggest this as a game to play on an already slow laptop, but any desktop and most laptops of middling speed/quality should be able to handle it. If you have a slow laptop (like mine was rip) the game will likely play, but the lag could be anywhere from workable to almost inoperable. Btw, this is exponentially compounded if you are trying to play with others. For example: a slow-ish game solo might become unplayable with a friend on the server even if by yourself it's doable. I've never written a game review before, so hopefully this is helpful for someone! I figured I had over a thousand hours just on this account so it was probably time to share my experiences with one of my go-to games:)

### 第一次真正让我沉浸进去的纯正 JRPG 《女神异闻录5》是我通关的第一款真正意义上的纯正 JRPG。 以前我其实对回合制 RPG 没什么兴趣，总觉得节奏比较慢，是属于旧时代的游戏类型。刚开始玩《女神异闻录5》的时候也是一样，前两个小时甚至没能让我真正玩进去。直到后来因为一个偶然的契机继续玩了下去，结果就一发不可收拾了。 不知不觉间，我开始真正沉浸进这个游戏的世界。 《女神异闻录5》让我第一次意识到，一款回合制 RPG 原来可以做得这么丰富。非常有辨识度的美术风格、优秀的人物塑造、精彩的剧情，还有从头到尾都非常好听的 BGM，这些东西组合在一起，让它成为我目前玩过的 JRPG 里非常顶级的一部作品。 如果要把它和其他 JRPG 放在一起比较，我觉得《女神异闻录5》完全可以和《异度之刃》系列一起站在 JRPG 第一梯队。 而《女神异闻录5》也是我第一次真正了解到 Atlus 这个公司。后来我开始去了解它的其他作品，包括《真·女神转生》系列。了解到《女神异闻录》本身就是从《真·女神转生》系列发展出来之后，再回头看《女神异闻录5》，会觉得它走的这条路线确实非常成功。 它保留了 Atlus 游戏中比较核心的战斗和养成体系，但又没有把门槛做得特别高，而是加入了大量校园生活、人物互动以及日常养成的内容。 每天和同学、队友以及各种 NPC 交流，发展彼此之间的关系；在有限的时间里安排自己的生活；然后进入宫殿探索、战斗、解谜，在关键的时间节点完成主线目标。 除此之外，还有各种小游戏和其他零零碎碎的内容。 这些系统单独拿出来可能都不算特别惊艳，但组合到一起之后，就形成了一种非常独特的体验。你会慢慢觉得自己不是单纯在“玩一个 RPG”，而是真的在经历一段属于这些角色的生活。 我觉得这也是《女神异闻录5》最吸引我的地方。 从系列的发展来看，《女神异闻录》也已经走过了三十多年的时间，而《女神异闻录5》某种程度上可以算是这个系列多年积累之后的一次集大成。无论是剧情、美术、音乐、人物塑造，还是 RPG、养成和日常系统之间的结合，都已经非常成熟。 当然，作为一款已经发行多年的游戏，它也不可能做到面面俱到。但即使放到现在来看，我依然觉得《女神异闻录5》是一款非常现代、非常有魅力的 JRPG。 这也是我第一次真正喜欢上一款传统回合制 RPG。 期待未来的《女神异闻录6》能够在《女神异闻录5》的基础上继续进化。毕竟距离《女神异闻录5》已经过去这么多年了，也希望下一作能够带来一次真正意义上的升级。 最后，感谢《女神异闻录5》让我第一次真正爱上 JRPG。 也期待下一次，再进入一个全新的“异闻录”世界。

我玩骑砍已经1000小时了，我曾经非常热爱这款游戏，我喜欢跑商、喜欢打仗、喜欢砍杀、喜欢下Mod、喜欢培养家族与同伴。 这是一款陪伴了我几乎整个大学时光的游戏，但是在今天我还是要给出差评。 我的差评针对无所作为、混吃等死、摆烂懒惰的烤肉社。你们曾经是一个伟大的工作室，从一对土耳其夫妇开始，创造了骑砍这样一个至今在中世纪大战场领域内没有竞品的游戏，满足了很多人骑马与砍杀的梦想；但是你们现在不配有任何的赞誉。 粗制滥造的DLC、多年不改善的陈旧外交与内政系统、单调乏味永远一模一样的卡拉迪亚大陆、从来不改善的底层代码，你们每天的工作就是躺在曾经的成功上悠闲地混吃等死，时不时动动手指改改表单中的几个数据，然后就堂而皇之地拿出来糊弄玩家，这就是你们烤肉社这个蔑称的由来 我曾花费数十个小时，寻找、下载、调试各类Mod，忍受百度网盘那半死不活的限速，权游、战锤、欧陆、流浪星星，每一个Mod都陪伴了我很长的时间，每一个也都曾因各种报错而困扰着我。 我曾花费数百个小时，假借你们这简陋的内政外交，幻想自己是卡拉迪亚的一位人物，我要如何地生活、战争、经营，我要如何走完我的中世纪一生，扮演行商，我从需要宰猪杀牛关注各种价格变化的小商贩，渐渐变成了坐拥两三百人、财富百万、囤积大量物资，轻而易举就能影响一座城市甚至一个国家物价的超级商人；扮演佣兵，我从那个打海寇都要小心骗标枪的小队长，渐渐成长为拥有数百精锐老部下，以及一众精心培养的家族子弟和同伴、战力能够决定一场战争走向的超级佣兵；扮演领主，我从欢天喜地平白获封一处小城堡、每天发愁赚钱养活军队的小领主，渐渐变成了一位控制整座大陆、开创全新时代、终结世界战乱的皇帝。 我曾花费数千个小时，憧憬我的人生会是什么样子的，会像游戏里的传奇人物一样吗？我会拥有骑士？长剑？战争？冒险？鲜花？挚爱？战友？传说？我这样的人有朝一日可不可能像小说里那样，穿越到异世界，开始一段独属于我的传奇旅程呢？我会拥有红颜知己吗？我会拥有超凡天赋吗？我会成为一位名扬天下的大人物吗？ 现在我醒了，我的大学生活结束了，我意识到那些会出现在小说人物里的穿越、系统、运气一样都没有出现在我身上，我只是我，一个马上就要面临就业与生活压力的我；我没有青梅竹马、没有随身系统、没有过人的天资、没有超群的智慧，我只是我，一个夜里常常为自己哭泣的我。 我没有你们这样肆意躺平的资本，我不敢也不能混日子，我的家庭还算美满，但也只是普通的小康，我们会为一顿火锅而期待，也会为一次七八十的自助而开心；我们会为一件几百块的衣服而心疼，也会为一张上千的机票而犹豫。我们只是普通人，不敢有太多奢望、不敢有太多放肆、不敢追求所谓自由的普通人。 但我想，我也不止是我，在中国，还有千千万万的人是像我这样的，我们不是这个时代的主角，也不是潮头之上的弄潮儿，我们没有可以傲慢和放纵的出身，也没人受人追捧和热爱的外貌，我们听说过许多美好，在互联网上见惯了昂贵的美食和奢靡的生活，我们曾经会幻想自己出人头地成为其中一员，每天只需要稍稍工作，就能轻易赚取足够享受的金钱。 但是我不得不知道，现实不是这样的，多数人的人生不是这样的，我们只能面对未知，我们没有兜底，我们注定庸碌。 人人生而不平等，世界生而不和谐。 不是每一个梦想都能实现，不是每一颗星星都能闪闪发光。 在过去与未来的深夜里，我依旧会为自己哭泣，也为我们哭泣。 再见了，骑砍，永别了，烤肉社。

Very unique take on the survival game genre, but really overshadowed by tedious and boring game mechanics. We found the game to be more fun when abusing its glitches and bugs. Everything I will be describing came from a multiplayer session with my friend. I don't have much experience regarding singleplayer. The first few hours of raft are extremely tedious. Sometimes a run can end because the game decides, that no resources will drift your way when you badly need them. The normal loot collection loop is insanely tedious and boring. The shark non-stop being on your ass doesn't make it more fun. The game expects you to collect an absolutely ridiculous amount of wood, plastic and metal. Planting trees on your raft barely speeds it up and collecting them by hand nets barely anything to work with. Plastic only drifts into your raft and metal, scrap etc come from gathering next to islands. Don't even get me started on the processing times for some of the materials via the Smelter. Many of the games mechanics artificially inflate your game time for no real reason. Weapon durability being low and no repair station make this even worse, since you have to always craft a completely fresh set of tools if they break. Gathering animals is insanely tedious. We beat the entire story without finding a single llama, because they just didn't spawn. Meanwhile, we had like 6 chickens and a goat. Equipment breaks really quick, to the point where it might not even be worth crafting. I expect the same with armor (we never crafted it). The bow has a learning curve behind it, but even after using it for 20 hours it still felt bad, especially against any flying enemy. To circumvent the absolutely tedious general gameplay loop, we starting dupping items via an exploit with saving and loading a backup. Problem is, that even with the huge amounts of resources, we didn't have enough for what we wanted to do/basic tools + basic infrastructure. I have no idea how the game expects you to collect so much wood, plastic, metal, scrap and titanium, when some recipes already take a large amount of it and that's just to craft said thing once. The game's story consists of random scattered notes and a few locations. It's just kinda there and not really super interesting. You could probably "beat" the game in less than 5 hours if you really tried. The story mostly serves to give you tools to survive better and move to the next story location. Some of the puzzles were fun / interesting, but a lot of the time it's very straightforward. Some where just "go here, find this, then come back". Those were not very fun. There are definitely a lot of bugs in multiplayer at least. A big one we encountered was, that the advanced controls caused the advanced anchor to be in a superposition. It was lowered for me, but not for the other player, causing the raft to glitch out. Some other meaningful ones I can mention are: completely negating fall damage, climbing walls vertically etc. Overall, the game expects you to put in a ridiculous amount of time gathering simple resources and doing the same thing over and over again (gathering treasure for example). Don't even get me started on the achievement list. It has to be one of the worst ones I've ever seen in a video game, nothing but do this x50 times for no real reason. No fun. The idea behind the game is good, but the execution of game mechanics really drags down the entire experience. I'm sure some people could enjoy a really slow paced survival game that takes real hours and that offers doing stuff over and over again. But I don't think tedious game mechanics and wasting your time for no reason is fun or engaging.

One of the most fun games I've ever played, It isn't perfect as it can get very grindy in many place of the game, but the loop of hunting monsters, getting better gear to hunt stronger monsters, to get even better gear rarely feels all that tedious because every hunt feel just that little different to spice things. This game has beautiful sights, models and maps, a complicated but mostly intuitive menu system and genuinely good balancing and hit boxes. The story isn't anything to write home about but its interesting enough for a game that is essentially a boss rush with semi-open environments to explore and gather resources. with friends (as with many games) its even more fun, as the game is built with cooperation and coordination with a group just as much if perhaps a bit more then with solo players. Not to mention it have an extremely open and friendly community who are always ready to help new players. In addition to this the dlc expansion Iceborne is actually bigger then the base game and offers more of the same while adding more then enough to justify a new expansion and reward the skills you refined in the base game. if you want a well paced combat focused game that lets you turn your brain off or lock in depending on your mood, or just need something to mess around with your group for hours on end without much muss or fuss. Monster Hunter World is already the game for you. Buy Monster Hunter World:Iceborne, you won't regret. P.S: Stay away from the guardian armor set and defender weapons they completely ruin the base game's progression and you will be very frustrated when you get to Iceborne and suddenly you aren't tanking damage like you used to. They are basically for speed running to the DLC. I made this mistake and nearly rage quit on one of the early bosses in the DLC cuz I just wasn't as good as the game expected me to be due to being carried by Guardian Armor, or Defender gear.

这条3k字长评是我的碎碎念合集，建议通关后食用。 今天100h+通关了，合理利用CT表地毯式游玩一周目全成就（立志不放过任何一个五块钱.jpg），玩的时候特别走火入魔，甚至凌晨三点还在玩...也许只有在大学时期尚且每天还有充足的，不被工作切割得细碎的闲暇时间才能全身心投入做东京帅气男高与怪盗的双面精彩生活吧。 当时玩p3就特别喜欢《color your night 》，p5的音乐同样也很好听。我很喜欢爵士乐，推荐双叶宫殿《母のいた日々》，还有丸喜宫殿《gentle madman 》《Ideal and the Real》和爵士俱乐部歌手来的bgm《No More What Ifs》。 ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 还记得25年8月我刚玩了一会是这样的想法： 谁家帅哥男主住脏乱差小阁楼啊，而且我要是一转学就收获一堆流言蜚语，亲眼目睹同学跳楼，自己被学校和家长像踢皮球一样踢来踢去，被只手遮天的老师像对日本人一样把我往死里整，我一个月写31封遗书 ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 但现在26年10月我通关了，确实可以来一句“P5r天下第一”。我是先玩P3r再来玩P5r的，明显感觉到游戏性这一块要比前者丰富有趣很多，感谢阿特拉斯让我可以经历如此有趣的旅程，以至于我20XX年3月19日是那么舍不得这个世界的所有人，把每个地点、每条街道、每个可互动的人和店铺都对话了一遍才依依不舍地回到了熟悉的卢布朗。 ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 梅子乌龙戴着黑手套淡然自若一枪把周可儿脑瓜崩出番茄酱四溅的样子特别帅啊。。优雅温柔的外壳和扭曲疯癫的内心并存的完美名侦探王子大人的子弹无论是物理还是浪漫象征意义上都可以贯穿我的心脏—— ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 然后以下是我昨天通关丸喜宫殿结局包含强烈个人主观看法的文字，严重剧透慎入： 抱着虽然明明罪大恶极但也不想让他死去的心情选择了丸喜创造的虚假现实。 虽然现实总是残酷且世界不以任何人的意志运行，但如果这是一条没有明明存在的时间线，那作为一个松饼推将是我不可承受之重……我不想让任何人带走他的生命，哪怕是他自己的意愿。明明存在的现实对他太过严苛太过冷血，世界咆哮着要把他的脖颈掐断，我要把他藏在一个安全、美好、幸福的世界里永远不让他再次被命运找到。 如果现实真的可以被「曲解」成所有人获得幸福的模样，我会毫不犹豫沉浸其中捂住耳朵蒙上眼睛不去想不去听不去看就这样过滤掉所有真实的杂质带来的任何痛楚，然后把挫折和苦难当做一种可咀嚼品味可随时暂停可调整体验程度的游戏。痛苦这种东西，何必所有的负面情绪都要自己亲身体会，既然世界上已经发明了电影、游戏、文学、音乐、戏剧等等表现形式，那就合理利用这些能让自己体验到他人情感的媒介享受。尽管我认为这样的环境扼杀了某些需要以极致的痛苦为驱动进行的创作，但我是一个中庸平淡的人，追求尽量舒适地活着又有什么不对呢。 所以我看到游戏谢幕时怪盗团成员们一个个都实现了自己的愿望，依旧在卢布朗嬉笑吵闹，这个世界是虚假的，但我注视着你们感受到了真正的幸福。 （不过今天通关真结局发现大家也是各自分散却朝着自己的目标努力着，这也是一种幸福。怪盗团好像只是一段都市传说，这个城市再也没有宫殿与印象空间，但只要大家彼此共有那段为全人类的未来奋斗过的记忆就已足够。） ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 以下是我玩的时候觉得不适的地方： 1.其实p5的coop剧情大部分都比较模板化……攻略对象出现了困难→牢莲像个夜神月一样询问造成麻烦的人名字→在印象空间解决虾抖让对方悔改→攻略对象察觉牢莲怪盗团身份。不过也不妨碍每个社群的故事其实都挺有意思的。我如果有莲这样的能力肯定拿来赚米去了，委托费五位数起步，三年不开张，开张吃三年。 2.对女角色有不必要的开黄腔或者猥琐的动作。比如双叶宫殿里有一段龙司俯视高卷杏胸部的动画，学园祭邀请杏她上台主角解围有“可以看到杏走光”这样的选项。虽说这是jrpg通病而且是十年前的游戏了能理解，但希望27年的P4r和P6不要出现满足宅男哥恶俗癖好的私货。 可以结合我去年的文字：感觉玩p5r的时候就会不自觉的从各个方面对比p3r，目前看到的两个女角色（高卷杏 芳泽霞）的怪盗服装设计还是不太舒服……又想到那句话。 “给女角色穿暴露的衣服，再赋予她美好的品质 就能让女coser们心甘情愿穿上qqny了” 还有UI方面，红黑主题的UI看久了容易让人烦躁，再加上这个男二，坂本龙司，性格和顺平也蛮像的。。热血莽撞爱开h腔。。看到他对高卷杏说话就挺无语的，明明是可以团结的力量却把她踢出去，大男子主义无敌了 综上所述，以我体验了三四个小时的p5r的感受来说 我是绝对不认可“p5r天下第一”这句话的。当很多宅男哥说出“xx游戏天下第一”时，你玩这个游戏就该保留一定的证伪态度了。（笑死左右脑互搏之人来了） 3.存档很不方便。你一年365天却只给15个存档位抠搜得要命，可以选择多名对象邀请时（如夏威夷、情人节、学园祭）不能存档。我本来想在丸喜宫殿最后一个安全屋存档结果不小心覆盖了所以看不了无印结局了，新作希望可以改进吧。 看着这如画般的一群人嬉笑打闹，怀揣着不舍的心情，和怪盗团说了再见。 第一次听说p5，是上高中的时候。看见粉丝逢人便说"P5天下第一！"，对此我不屑一故（笑），觉得不过是狂热粉丝的吹捧，小众圈子的优越感共鸣（诚然那时候女神异闻录系列已经因为P5全球出圈）。高中的学习生活已经近乎占据了我一切时间，整个三年都被压得喘不过气。人们都说作为学生只需要做好自己的本职工作就好了（笑），根本无需过多操心家人的情况、别人行为的好坏、朋友的关系，似乎连我本人是否过的开心、自由也成了身外之物。 彼时高中生的我无法想象一群生活在东京的同龄人竟然还能经历如此天马行空的生活，更无法共鸣雨宫莲一行人即使承受整个社会、整个国家的偏见也要去贯彻始终的正义，觉得这不过只是一群热血青年与大反派智斗的老套故事罢了，我不关心这个，更不需要这个。经历了高考、大学毕业，终于以为自己能有所成长，内心变得强大，喜怒不形于色，再也不因他人的事情影响自身。然而成人的世界才是充满压力与绝望，不抱有期待，就不会再受伤，我想以此来欺骗自己。和那些被社会压迫到只剩自保的人没什么两样：他们用扭曲自保，我用麻木自保。终于，不得不去承认，那被我随意地抛在一边恣意贬低的高中生活，似乎也不是那么暗淡无光了。 真正玩这个游戏已经是研究生阶段了。整个游玩的过程中，我的内心就像洋葱被一层一层拨开，那些往日被我唾弃的无聊的反抗精神，似乎不再是口头上的一句空话，而是会催人前进的力量。这时我才意识到P5的魅力：一个个看似简单的故事，不是无谓的白日做梦和逃避现实，而是我们每一个成年人平淡生活里的英雄梦想。它没有许诺一个乌托邦，怪盗团到最后也没能把社会改成理想模样，他们只是让一些人重新开始自己做选择—而这一点，恰恰是成年人最需要、也最容易放弃的东西。我早已不再期许去简单爽快地打倒生活中的大反派，而是共鸣于做出“可以不再欺骗自己”这一选择的艰难。 当我意识到这一点的时候，虽说称不上无聊的大人，但我大概已经不再是那个可以完全可以不处处听从老师、家人的想法，不被他人的眼光限制的曾经的自己。不过意识到这一点已经弥足珍贵，我不需要回到高中补一场叛逆，我更庆幸在现在的生活里，我对某件事仍然愿意期待，对某个人仍然愿意受影响，对某个不公仍然愿意不舒服。

I wanted to enjoy Black Myth: Wukong, but I could not get a clean-looking image on my 1440p RTX 5060 PC. I tried DLSS at different resolution levels, DLAA, frame generation on and off, high texture/hair/anti-aliasing settings, ray tracing off, sharpening adjustments, and monitor settings. The main issue was that Wukong’s hair often looked dotted, grainy, or distorted. Foliage and thin environmental details also looked unstable and shimmery. Lowering sharpening made the character’s face and clothes look too blurry, while increasing it made the visual artefacts stand out even more. The combat and world seem promising, but I spent too much time trying to fix the graphics and could not enjoy the game in this state.

Also still the most alive feeling open world game I've played to date. I feel less inclined to murder random npcs on the street because of that, same with enemies. Начну, пожалуй, со слабых мест. Основным из них, традиционно для серии, является сюжет. Он тут чисто для галочки, чтобы объяснить нам причину, по которой нам нужно бить разных чудищ и залезать во всё более укромные уголки этого мира. Звуковое сопровождение. Тут мне не к чему придраться, у значимых чудовищ есть собственные саундтреки, так что можно по музыке узнать кто на тебя выпрыгнул со спины. Звуки мира и чудищ отлично сгущают атмосферу недружелюбного к человеку мира, а пафосные аккорды придают сил в нелёгких сражениях. Графика и техническое состояние отличное. Даже на стимдеке стабильно держит свои 45 кадров. Не назову это каким-то некстгеном, игре уже всё-таки восемь лет, но она не ощущается устаревшей. Мир отлично читается, глаза тут же цепляются за значимые вещи, чтобы быстро оценить ситуацию на поле. В то же время порой можно выйти на прекрасные виды заходящего солнца с какого-нибудь обрыва. Ну, а теперь к тому, ради чего люди вообще эту серию берут: геймплей и прокачка. Почти со старта нам выдают оружия всех 14 видов и ведут в тренировочную комнату - пробуй! Это, наверное, самое важное решение в игре. Все оружия кардинально отличаются по геймплею. С глефой или двумя клинками ты будешь играть в слэшер. С луком или легким лукорудием - в тактический шутер. С тяжёлыми типами вооружения получишь солслайк, где каждое движение нужно продумывать, иначе есть шанс оказаться в невыгодном положении прямо во время удара противника. С длинным мечом - самурайский боевик с резкими выхватами из ножен и точными выпадами! С охотничьим рогом ты играешь за саппорта, в том числе для себя. А заряженный клинок превращает тебя в боевого бухгалтера, которому точно нужно бдить балансы зарядов и расчитывать когда и на какой вид оружия нужно переключиться, когда его зарядить, а когда превратить в трёхметровое убер-молотило. Но тут есть важный нюанс: оружие ты выбираешь не по тому, какой геймплей тебя вдохновляет, а по тому, с какими его минусами ты готов мириться: Тяжелые оружия - проблемы с мобильностью. Легкие - постоянно нужно за чем-то следить: выносливостью, остротой, патронами, чем-то его заряжать и пр. А рог - это вообще отдельная миниигра при каждом баффе, ни на что не похожий опыт прохождения. Безусловно, у каждого из них есть плюсы перед другими, но это дело второстепенное. Важнее, чтобы оружие не бесило тебя долгие 100+ часов. И тут самый удивительный момент: оружие настолько разнообразно, что для каждого находится что-то своё. И то что тебе кажется неиграбельным, другой игрок оценит "а норм, с этим вполне можно жить". А когда освоишь своё оружие, то уже точно не захочешь поменять его на что-то другое до конца игры. Почему так важно правильно определиться с оружием в начале? Потому что оружие прокачивается тут по дереву прокачки. И если ты, дорогой читатель, вдруг решишь сменить его посередине игры, то тебе не только придётся его с нуля освоить, но и прокачать нужное тебе по уровню ковыряло с самого начала. Но это обычно не очень сложно, т.к. скорее всего у тебя будут излишки лута с прошлых походов, а боссов начальных уровней по мере прокачки бить становится совсем просто. В общем, боевая система тут сложна и непривычна, но она однозначно стоит того, чтобы в неё углубиться. Те же солсы во многом были вдохновлены (если не сказать "списаны") с Monster Hunter. И вторая вещь, которая вызывает недоумение в начале игры, а по окончанию ты осознаёшь насколько она продумана до мелочей, это интерфейс. В игре уйма кнопочек в разных менюшках и порой нужно спрашивать у интернета как сделать ту или иную вещь. Обязательно читайте легенду для кнопок под каждым меню, а то можете пропустить очень удобные штуки. И вот когда ты ознакомишься со всеми механиками, то начинаешь понимать, что СТОЛЬКО возможностей невозможно распихать на простом интерфейсе. Тут одновременно нужно и уметь крафтить лечилки, и выбирать снаряды для самострела, и руководить палико, и смайликами общаться, и ловушки ставить, и многое другое, зачастую, прямо во время боя! И авторы справились с этим просто потрясно: есть четыре круговых меню (выбираешь нужное действие стиком) и меню быстрого доступа (чтобы просто нажав на X выбранное действие выполнилось). И когда это всё под себя настроишь - то ощущаешь себя асом истребителя, настолько всё четко и слажено получается. Но есть и промашки, поэтому если вы что-то увидели и не знаете что это, зачем оно нужно или откуда взять - спросите у интернета или ИИ, некоторые вещи авторы оставили для самых пытливых исследователей. Например, я только через 120+ часов игры понял, что палико (про них чуть позже) можно менять инструменты и он может не только лечить! Это было такое прозрение, которое поменяло игру на до и после. А почему я не сделал этого раньше? Про это в следующем разделе. Система заданий: в игре есть сюжетные, дополнительные, событийные и особые задания, и расследования. Так вот, за годы их наделали столько разных, что глаза разбегаются. И вот тут кроется главная ошибка: дополнительные задания стоит выполнять практически все. Даже если там нет очевидных призов в описании, то прохождение может дать проход к нужному заданию или просто выпадет что-то крайне полезное. Так я и профукал за одним невыполненным заданием без приза в описании длинную цепочку прокачки своего главного помощника - палико. О палико: это прямоходящий кот, который помогает тебе если игрешь один или вдвоём. Т.к. в пати не может быть больше 4 членов, то при игре вчетвером палико остаются в стороне. Он прокачивается вместе с тобой и обрастает арсеналом весьма полезных инструментов. Так что не пропускайте его квесты, т.к. инструменты отнюдь не единственная причина, по которой стоит пройти все дополнительные квесты компаньона. Особенно, если играете в одиночку. С сюжетными, думаю, всё понятно. Событийные - скорее проверка умений. Они часто требуются в еженедельных квестах и за них дают неплохую награду. А особые квесты - это DLC и походы на самых элитных боссов. Тут по желанию, я пропустил всякие кроссоверы, а остальные все прошёл. В одном из таких квестов получил самую полезную накидку в игре. Про онлайн: несмотря на почётные 8 лет с выхода, онлайн в игре стабилен. Почти всегда на трудных боссов можно призвать помощь. Однако, в сюжетных миссиях сначала нужно посмотреть сюжетные же вставки, а только после них откроется возможность призыва. Про трудных боссов: думаю всех их вполне можно пройти в одиночку, но я не советую. В одиночку можно и задушниться, мне кажется, даже если играешь с нонеймами из сети. В первую очередь - это кооперативная игра. И двух человек тут вполне достаточно, чтобы сделать её незабываемой и обрести кучу совместных воспоминаний. Однако, не стоит забывать, что каждая охота требует подготовки: нужная броня и камни в ней, подходящее оружие, лечилки и антидоты, ловушки, и, главное, хорошо покушать перед заходом - всё это крайне важно для успеха. Если выполнить все пункты, то даже самый трудный босс не устоит перед вашим напором. Ну и в конце: почему именно World, а не более новые Rise или Wilds? По тому, что я прочёл в интернетах, именно World до сих пор остаётся вершиной серии: по количеству контента, по оптимизации, по разнообразию механик и пр. Поэтому если вы хотели попробовать эту серию и разобраться что так много людей в ней нашло, то это лучшая точка входа по моему мнению. TLDR: если хотите коопертивное приключение про выслеживание и охоту на огромных драконов со вдумчивыми боями часов на 150-200, то вам однозначно сюда. Если вам совсем не с кем играть, но хочется попробовать непривычную, но очень интересную систему боя, то тоже стоит попробовать. Благо игра сейчас со всеми дополнениями стоит совсем немного. Если это всё не про вас, то можете просто кинуть в желаемое, т.к. товар штучный и желание поиграть в него когда-нибудь может прийти. Игра возрождает внутри то детское ощущение исследования неизведанного мира, различных механик и систем, которое многие из нас по мере взросления могли потерять.

Half-Life 2... The game still is very good, even all these years after its release. The world is full of life, the sound design and music are phenomenal, and the PHYSICS are something I still don’t see in today’s most modern games. It’s fun, it has an incredible lore, and I completely understand why people call it one of the best games ever made. If it’s still this good today, I can’t imagine how revolutionary it must have felt to play back then. One of the things I appreciate most, besides the physics, is the “chase scenes.” They’re common in games: you hop into a vehicle and have to drive, either to escape or to chase an enemy. Until Half-Life, I always said I didn’t like them. They felt forced, and even though I was the one driving, it seemed like the game was just telling me where to go. But Half-Life completely changed how I see scenes like these. The driving is so good, satisfying, and freeing that I ended up loving every moment behind the wheel. And nobody can take away the joy I felt every time I lost all my items and finally got the gravity gun back. It’s incredible how much fun simple mechanics can be when they’re well implemented. I absolutely recommend Half-Life 2. Here’s a phenomenal quote that sums up the whole experience of the game: “The right man in the wrong place can make all the difference in the world.”

When the original Half-Life was released it completely changed the genre forever. It showed that a FPS didn't have to just be a run and gun shooter in 3D. You could have a film like story and narrative, with acting and events. You were in a story that progressed with you. And with the Source remake it's worth playing again, Half-Life 2 took this to another level of immersion. You really felt like you were in the game world, and not just trying to reach the end of a level. It has so many memorable set pieces and events. I've played through the whole game multiple times and still smile every time I reach certain points. The prison section being one of my favourites. Most games released in 2004 looks very dated these days. Blocky primitive 3D objects and characters, low resolution textures. But somehow Half-Life 2 still looks as great as it did the day it was released. And the updates Valve made to the game for the Steam Deck release just shows how the developers never abandon their games. They are made with a passion and supported forever where possible. I replayed though the whole game again on the Steam Deck and it was just as great, if not even better thanks to the Gyro aiming, which really adds a new level of control to any FPS. This is not just IMO the greatest First Person Shooter ever created, but one of the greatest games ever made.

Got this game for free on Epic, decided to buy it here cuz fuck epic but also this game deserves the money. Insanely mechanically tight, it will put your keyboard / controller's buttons (especially the fucking Dpad) under severe scrutiny, especially in the last few challenges. I'd rather not spoil anything tough, you wanna experience every level and feature blind. The story is neat. I remember really liking it when I first played it, now I'm kinda meh on it, but that's probably just cuz of the state of mind I'm in. It's an analogy for overcoming hardships (not some tranny shit as "the tolerant and inclusive" communities on the internet would have you believe) However, I think it's beyond retarded to give a game with this theme a fucking practice mode. Wtf was the dev thinking with that one I have no idea. Do not touch it, the intended experience is to figure every room out or die trying, not getting a fucking cheatmode to stroll through and find every secret without a hitch. There are very very few instances of the game cheating, I don't recall them all anymore, but the most recent one is, for instance, a certain block falling faster than others when it fucking shouldn't in the hardest level (excluding the DLC). These are very rare, but they will piss you the fuck off since they have a major impact. I guess I should say that I have not finished Farewell yet, I just finished everything else though and now I'm taking a fucking break. Overall this game is a 9/10, and very close to a 9.5 at that. Mechanically tighter than any mario game, almost as consistent as fucking chess, despite being quite simple in the amount of mechanics the game provides. It milks them to the maximum and expects you to master them all. Also the soundtrack is great, a shame the C sides do not have a unique variation of the track, and also Golden Ridge Remix sucks ass.

There is a Mod that seems like it would fit into Bannerlord perfectly, I beg of you, make the "DynaCulture" mod a vanilla Sandbox modifier, Please. A quick rundown on what it does, if a faction holds a fief for long enough, that fief will start changing cultures, there's a lot of options for it, but even a basic version would be loved. A note that I really like, the culture change is NOT instant, recruits from villages will be half and half, I also pair it with the "Change a Vassals Culture" and "Change a Companions Culture". Seeing this introduced would be one of the coolest things ever, and with the recent additions to the sandbox mode, it seems more possible than ever. Imagine being in the Nordic faction, and sailing all the way around the world to conquer the Aserai, just to make a "Southern Nordic Enclave. This could really introduce new goals for the game, not to conquer, but to make a kingdom of enclaves all over and try to protect them. Watching kingdoms change borders, and having their culture follow could be the coolest thing ever, not to mention it would make it easier for players to create custom maps. I LOVE the game, and don't want to have this come up as useless criticism, but I truly beg of you to let vanilla-only player experience that side of bannerlord.

My first Monster Hunter game, and honestly, I had a great time with it. I'd definitely recommend giving it a try, whether you're playing solo or with friends. The gameplay is all about learning monster movesets, observing their patterns, and getting better at your own weapons. It's not just about getting the biggest numbers and hoping for the best. Or you can just button-mash and hope for the best. We've all been there. There's a huge variety of weapons, so you're bound to find something you enjoy. And the gameplay loop is pretty fun: hunt colossal monsters, turn them into cool armor, and dress up your cat in matching gear. Yes, your cat can wear monster armor too. Fashion is important, even when you're out committing monster genocide. The visuals are vibrant, and the environments look great. Some assets are showing their age, but you can always grab the high resolution texture pack. The maps aren't huge, but there's a surprising amount of detail, and each biome has its own ecosystem. Even though Monster Hunter Wilds is more popular now, there's still a decent player base, so finding people to hunt with isn't a problem. Now excuse me, there's a monster out there that would look great as a hat.

Being born in '99 means I was just a kid during the peak Halo hype, but this franchise completely defined my childhood. Getting The Master Chief Collection on Steam feels like repossessing my youth in the absolute best way possible. Having Reach, CE, Halo 2, Halo 3, ODST, and Halo 4 living together in one launcher is insane value. Getting to replay these campaigns at an ultra-smooth frame rate feels incredible. Toggling between the classic 2004 graphics and the gorgeous Halo 2 Anniversary remakes gives me intense flashbacks to split-screen LAN parties with friends. The matchmaking mixer is perfect too. bouncing from a chaotic Big Team Battle in Halo 3 straight into a tight Slayer match on Reach never gets old. If you want a flawless preservation of the absolute best era of gaming, this is it. 10/10. Wake up, Chief.

# One of the Best AAA Games I’ve Ever Played *Black Myth: Wukong* is easily one of the best AAA games I’ve played, and it has definitely earned a spot in my Top 10. The game is heavily story-driven and draws inspiration from *Journey to the West*. I recommend learning a little about the original story beforehand if you want a deeper understanding of the game's narrative and characters. However, even if you go in completely blind, like I did, you'll still have a fantastic experience. For me, **the combat and boss designs are among the absolute best parts of the game.** Every encounter feels exciting, and the variety of bosses keeps things interesting throughout your journey. One thing worth mentioning is that the game isn't as punishing as many other Souls-like games. In fact, I wouldn't consider it a traditional Souls-like, despite what some people might expect. That doesn't mean it's easy, though! Certain bosses can be genuinely challenging, and you'll sometimes need to experiment with different builds, abilities, and strategies to overcome them. The game is also packed with secrets and hidden content. There's no shame in looking things up on YouTube if you get stuck or want to discover something you missed. Even after completing the game, there's still plenty to explore, and a second playthrough can be well worth your time. **Overall, I absolutely love this game.** It's easily one of my favourite gaming experiences and has secured a place in my personal Top 10. I would definitely recommend *Black Myth: Wukong* if you have the patience, enjoy action RPGs, and want a game that offers fantastic combat, memorable boss fights, and a satisfying level of challenge. Absolutely worth getting!

Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a good game overall and one of the most interesting medieval sandbox games available. Building your clan, creating your own kingdom, commanding armies, and fighting massive battles can keep you entertained for hundreds of hours. The game offers a level of freedom that very few strategy RPGs can match. My biggest issue with the game is the lack of a co-op campaign. Bannerlord feels like the perfect game to play with friends. Imagine leading different clans in the same world, fighting together in battles, managing kingdoms, or conquering Calradia as a team. It is disappointing that this feature was never added, and I honestly believe it is the game's biggest weakness. I hope that if Bannerlord 3 ever gets made, TaleWorlds finally adds a proper co-op mode. Another major problem is smithing. The system is extremely unbalanced. You can start with around 5,000 coins and, after only 2-3 hours of smithing, end up with several million. This makes trading, workshops, caravans, and many other money-making methods feel almost pointless. The problem is that you cannot simply ignore smithing either. While you can choose not to use it for making money, you will miss out on some of the best weapons in the game. Crafted weapons can easily outperform most equipment you can find or buy, making smithing feel almost mandatory if you want the strongest gear. I also think the crafting system could be expanded. It would be great if we could craft armor, not stronger or unique armor, but simply the armor pieces that already exist in the game. Sometimes finding a specific armor set is a complete headache because of how random shops and loot can be. Being able to craft existing armor for yourself and your troops would be a great quality-of-life feature without hurting game balance. Another feature I would love to see is the ability to create custom troop trees. Instead of relying entirely on existing faction troops, players could design and equip their own units. Creating a unique army that reflects your kingdom's culture and fighting style would make the late game much more enjoyable and add another layer of customization. Combat is generally good, but some mechanics feel questionable. Crossbows not being able to penetrate shields feels strange. It is also a bit silly when a fully maxed-out warrior with a two-handed sword or axe gets his attack blocked by an enemy carrying a tiny wooden hammer. These moments can break immersion and make combat feel less believable than it should. The AI is decent, but nothing special. It is not terrible, but it is far from great. Sometimes kingdoms gather huge armies only to run around the map without accomplishing much. Instead of capturing settlements or defending their territory, they often wander around seemingly without a clear objective. One mechanic that I actually like is that axes and some polearms can cleave through multiple enemies in a single swing. It makes weapon choice more meaningful and gives those weapons a unique advantage. At the same time, it is disappointing that most other weapons cannot do the same. A massive two-handed greatsword should not stop after hitting a single enemy while an axe can cut through several soldiers. I think more weapon types should have access to this mechanic, especially larger two-handed weapons. Another thing that stands out is how much the game relies on its modding community. Sometimes it feels like Bannerlord is still alive because of modders constantly adding new content, fixing issues, and expanding gameplay. It is great that the community is so passionate and talented, and many mods genuinely improve the game. However, I think the developers should be doing more themselves instead of relying on the community to solve many of the game's shortcomings. A good example is the Diplomacy mod. Features from that mod should already be part of the base game. Managing a kingdom can become frustrating because you often have to chase NPCs all over the map just to talk to them. For example, recruiting a clan to your kingdom can turn into a long game of hide-and-seek. Diplomatic actions should be easier to handle, and some form of messaging system, diplomacy menu, or improved kingdom management would make the experience much smoother. As for multiplayer, it is mostly for a specific audience. Some players enjoy it a lot, while others will spend almost all their time in single-player. It is not bad, but it feels less popular and less interesting than the campaign experience. Overall, Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a very good game with excellent large-scale battles, a unique sandbox experience, and plenty of replayability. Despite issues such as unbalanced smithing, average AI, basic diplomacy, and some questionable combat mechanics, the game remains one of the best medieval war simulators available today. However, the missing co-op campaign is what prevents it from reaching its full potential for me. I hope TaleWorlds learns from Bannerlord's strengths and weaknesses and makes Bannerlord 3 a much better game. If they add co-op, improve diplomacy, balance smithing, introduce custom troop creation, armor crafting, smarter AI, and larger battles, I genuinely believe it could dominate the medieval sandbox genre for a very long time. I'm also looking forward to Chronicles: Medieval, which is currently planned for release in 2027. Competition is always good because it pushes developers to improve their games. I think Chronicles: Medieval has the potential to be a strong competitor to Bannerlord 2. However, if TaleWorlds addresses the major issues mentioned above in a future Bannerlord 3, I believe it would be on another level entirely and could remain the dominant medieval warfare sandbox game for years.

P5r，一则灰色现实下的童话歌剧 稚嫩的高中生们戴上假面，游走于社会暗面，将一封封预告信化作子弹射出，向“大人们”举起反旗——你一眼就知道它又是一出结构俗套的剧目。 可看着他们纵身跃上舞台，跨过一个接一个宫殿，肩并肩走到舞台中央直面终局……当决战的音乐响起，你还是会情不自禁，你还是会相信这是一个动人的故事，结局的演出不够盛大，可让这段旅程真正拥有重量的不是最后的“高燃演出”，而是一路走来见证的所有。 【！！！以下内容涉及强剧透与少许不满！！！】 “大侦探”明智与“女路人”芳泽 这两位人物是我短短怪盗生涯的最大意难平，明智没有支付 “代价” ，芳泽“霞”没有展现 弧光 。 首先是周可儿的“宿敌”，大侦探明智。坦白说这个角色登场到中期我才意识到这是个与周可儿对称的宿敌型角色，二人的关系是时刻紧绷着的一根线，在平静下双方暗暗的角力，保持着一个微妙的平衡关系。但这根平衡线剪的太过粗暴了，明智的背叛是我有所预料的，但明智的反差爆发是令我难蚌的，我不是在批评真实的明智人设如何（相反我更喜欢他放开后的性格），而是在说故事上明智的背叛几乎完全颠覆了他之前的理念与作为。 初登场的明智所秉持的程序正义是与怪盗团的道德正义一次极好的理念碰撞，明智也确确实实直白的在这个时期对周可儿下了决斗通牒，直白的说出了自己视周可儿为劲敌的念头，然后呢？然后他就成为了那个歇斯底里的明智。 拙劣的阴谋被怪盗团早早识破，背地里的言论与在宫殿最后一战的宣言更是宣告了所有的理念和坚持都化作飞灰，一切的一切都是为了最后自己焚尽所有的复仇大戏。他的复仇计划在师童眼中毫无威胁，自己更是在最后一战被三言两语动摇选择救下怪盗团，他作为反派本应有的闪光都被模糊放弃掉了，成为了一个为黑而黑的，为对称而对称的【宿敌】。 最后最后是我最不能接受的，就是无人审判他，明智不应有一个模糊的悬念结局，他需要一个结局，一段判词，一则明确的【裁决】。虽然P5r整体叙事上升到了对整个社会的反抗，但它的底色确实仍保留了童话的一面，不愿伤人，执着的拯救世人的怪盗团为什么会放任一个手上占满鲜血的人在世间自由行走，春的父亲怎么办，双叶的母亲又会怎么想，为什么她们二人能自如的在最后原谅这个【罪犯】？ 在师童宫殿时明智最后的舍身只称得上是偿还，我对此毫无感激，而当我看到第三学期的明智是周可儿的愿望时更是让我产生了游玩P5r以来最大的不适感，如果一定要复活他，那是要为了让他为其恶行赎罪，而不是为了什么堂堂正正的决斗。 而霞，我亲爱的红发女路人。其实她的个人剧情量确实不算少，但是整体的塑造却极其的【慵懒】，是编剧执笔上的慵懒。 霞在一、二学期的剧情只是纯粹的隔靴搔痒，既没有对主线产生大幅度的影响，也没有与怪盗团产生过深的联系，几乎只是一个在周可儿身边打转的可爱学妹。一二学期的P5r只是一个劲的在霞身上埋伏笔，开场对怪盗团理念的反对，中期面具的觉醒和始终无法忘怀的伤痛都预示着这个角色埋藏着更多的故事，可一二学期中的霞真的是有万般理由远离所有怪盗团活动，她的出场与其说是塑造人物，不如说是在吊人胃口。 当真正等到第三学期，真正需要为这个人物动笔时，编剧却又将之前赋予霞的一个个特质扁平化，然后无视掉，使其回归成一个平庸可爱的花瓶角色。她被救回怪盗团时的再觉醒极其迅速生硬。哪怕她在丸喜的乐园再多沉溺挣扎几日，与怪盗团多进行几次碰撞，霞这一人物都有再升华塑造的可能，但霞几乎是被周可儿一巴掌打飞然后立刻踏上了讨伐丸喜的道路。个人COOP中也只是在延续前两个学期的“可爱学妹”标签，对于姐姐的痛苦与思考本可以在COOP中进一步挖掘却也是重拿轻放，将更多的笔墨放在了与周可儿二人转上，姐姐就像霞坏掉的手机一样，只是一个理由、一个钩子罢了。结局动画女路人的淡漠行为更是给了这名角色的塑造重重一击，即便我早已听说这一结局，真正看到时也是哑口无言。 凑凑忙忙的第三学期 用笼统的话来概括，P5r整体的主线是经典王道故事的一种再演。可以说它套路重复、故事俗套，但总有人喜欢（起码我很喜欢），可令人遗憾的是，这个故事绝对称不上圆满落幕。 作为承接无印剧情的第三学期，新增的怪盗团coop剧情套路化严重，本身在无印结局前已经使用过的套路化手法一扭头又见到一次，没有太多铺垫与修改，周可儿只是看着团员排排队找你进化，然后再无波澜。第三学期我几乎只是补完最后几人的满COOP然后就只能天天丢飞镖打台球，丸喜的执着和理念被过度内化在周可儿与丸喜的个人剧情中，丸喜对除了周可儿以外的团员影响也过早的被清除。 还是如对霞的思考一样，如果团员们或多或少在丸喜的乐园多沉沦几日，或许就能有更多的笔墨去同时拓展丸喜和团员们的塑造，而不是简单的喊几句热血口号就再度高举反抗的旗帜。

A decent game ruined by corporate greed. The core game is genuinely good, and there’s a lot to enjoy in Dying Light 2. Unfortunately, Techland’s relentless monetization keeps dragging the experience down. The constant push to buy overpriced cosmetics is bad enough, with loading screens feeling more like advertisements than part of an actual game. And now they want to charge extra for spatial audio in their latest update? Seriously? At some point, it stops feeling like a company supporting its game and starts feeling like a company squeezing every last penny out of its players. It’s a shame, because the game itself has a solid foundation, but these greedy practices make it difficult to respect the people behind it. My advice? Stop rewarding this behavior with your money. If you absolutely want to play it, wait for a deep discount. Don’t pay full price just to be bombarded with monetization, and don’t encourage the idea that basic features and overpriced cosmetics are acceptable ways to milk a player base. Speak with your wallet. The only language these companies seem to understand is money, and if enough players refuse to play along, they might finally reconsider these practices. You have more power as a consumer than you think. Use it.

TLDR: I would have loved to see extra time and care put into this game, as I feel the core gameplay loop is great. I feel devastated when I play this game because of the wasted potential that I am reminded of. The core loop of building your army, sieging enemy fortresses and fighting battle after battle is incredibly addicting. However, I feel like the game is missing the more in depth aspects that would make it a masterpiece and a genre defining title. Certain parts of the game lack depth and can be frustrating to engage with. Diplomacy, dialogue, familial systems, companion systems, and battlefield strategy feel like aspects of the game that weren't given enough love by the devs, which is frustrating because in the late game they are tend to be important systems that need can't be ignored. I have to commend the devs on building a world that doesn't make you the main character. I absolutely love the feeling that everyone has independent motivations, and seeing all the armies and caravans go about their business is great. However, it's an illusion that quickly falls away once you gain more power in your playthrough. Ultimately the goal of becoming the ruler of the lands makes for a fun, engaging game with a strong core loop. I just feel sad when I think about how much more interesting the game could be if it had more depth.

Even so, my stats are kind of embarrassing—across all these seasons, I've only actually made it to the maps twice. The game is brutal! When I first started, I couldn't get past level 50 or reach Act 6 without constantly dying. I would rage quit, uninstall, leave the game for months, and then inevitably come back when a new league dropped to try again. And that is the beauty of PoE. Every single time I came back, I learned something new, got a bit better, and pushed a little further. The sheer depth and content of this game never get old. The build variety and complexity are unmatched, and no matter how many times it kicks my teeth in, I will always come back to check out a new league. Verdict: It's punishing, it has a legendary learning curve, and it will humble you—but it is an absolute masterpiece of an ARPG. Highly recommended if you love deep, endlessly rewarding progression.
